rachats.citation: Specialty Networks Acquisition On March 18, 2024, we completed the acquisition of Specialty Networks for a purchase price of $1.2 billion in cash, subject to certain adjustments.

Subsequent Events Solaris Health On August 12, 2025, we announced that we, through GIA, have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Solaris Health, a urology MSO, for a purchase price of approximately $ 1.9 billion in cash, subject to certain adjustments.

Additionally, on May 30, 2025, we, through GIA, completed the acquisition of Urology America, a urology management services organization, for a purchase price of $360 million in cash, subject to certain adjustments.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
